name: labs/unine-chyn__thorpy
title: Thorlabs APT stage (Thorpy)
intro: Thorlabs APT stage (Thorpy), adapted from unine-chyn/thorpy. It reads `homed`; sets `position`, `max_velocity` and `acceleration`; runs `home` and `stop_motion`. `home`: start a home move and wait until the controller reports homed. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/unine-chyn__thorpy --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/unine-chyn__thorpy --backend fake --mcp
